description: Template-agnostic generator for ace-web video programs. Ingests a template's structured data (meta + intent + skeleton + example), fills every {{placeholder}} from a source (program-page URL, pasted brief, or prospect research), substitutes into the skeleton, validates, and POSTs the complete spec to ace-web. Works for every video template; no per-template prompt required. Owns one artifact: the new program's spec.yaml in Drive.
